description: Create a payout to a bank card, YooMoney wallet, or SBP. Requires the separately-activated YooKassa Payouts product with its own credentials (see README/SECURITY). Asynchronous — the response may be 'pending'; poll get_payout for the final status. MOVES REAL MONEY — irreversible.

bank_id.description: SBP participant bank id (required for destination_type=sbp)

destination_type.description: Recipient type (if not using payout_token). bank_card requires a PCI DSS certificate

destination_value.description: Recipient: card number (bank_card), wallet number (yoo_money), or phone 79XXXXXXXXX (sbp)

payout_token.description: Recipient token from the payout widget (preferred; required if you lack PCI DSS to accept a raw card number)

name: create_payout
title: Create payout
